title: Replace audio file uploads with URL inputs for both Audio 1 and Audio 2 slots

requirements.summary: Replace Audio 1 and Audio 2 file upload inputs with URL text inputs and label fields in ChapterForm, removing all chunked-upload logic, progress bars, and file state
acceptanceCriteria: ChapterForm shows a URL text input and a label text input for Audio 1.
ChapterForm shows a URL text input and a label text input for Audio 2.
No file input, file state, progress bar, or chunked-upload logic for audio exists anywhere in ChapterForm.
Entering any URL (YouTube, Google Drive, direct .mp3/.mp4, etc.) in either audio URL field and saving persists the URL to the canister via createChapter/updateChapter.
audioLabel1 and audioLabel2 values are included in the chapter payload sent to the canister.
When editing an existing chapter, the audio URL fields are pre-populated with the stored URL values.
The Save button is not disabled by empty audio URL fields; a chapter with only a title saves successfully.
No import or usage of audioUploadService.ts or audioUploadService2.ts remains in ChapterForm.tsx.
The save progress indicator no longer includes audio upload chunk steps; it reflects only metadata create/update.

file_operations.description: Remove all file upload inputs, File state variables, progress bar UI, and chunked-upload logic (uploadAudioChunk, uploadAudioChunk2, finalizeAudioUpload, finalizeAudioUpload2) for both Audio 1 and Audio 2. Replace with two plain text input fields for Audio 1: one for the audio URL (placeholder: 'Audio 1 URL — any link (YouTube, Google Drive, direct, etc.)') and one for the optional label (placeholder: 'Audio 1 Label'). Add two corresponding text input fields for Audio 2: one for the audio URL (placeholder: 'Audio 2 URL — any link (YouTube, Google Drive, direct, etc.)') and one for the optional label (placeholder: 'Audio 2 Label'). Update the form state to include audioUrl1 and audioUrl2 string fields. Remove imports of audioUploadService.ts and audioUploadService2.ts. Update the save handler to pass audioUrl1 and audioUrl2 directly in the ChapterInput payload to createChapter/updateChapter without any upload steps. Ensure the save progress indicator no longer shows audio chunk upload steps. When editing an existing chapter, pre-populate audioUrl1 and audioUrl2 fields with stored values from the chapter object.

requirements.summary: Update ChapterPage Audio tab and AudioPlayer to play audio using stored URL strings directly, without fetching binary data from the canister
acceptanceCriteria: The Audio tab on the Chapter page shows one button/card per available audio URL using the admin-entered label (fallback: 'Audio 1' / 'Audio 2').
Clicking an audio button passes the stored URL string to the AudioPlayer component for immediate playback.
No calls to getAudioData or getAudioData2 canister functions exist in ChapterPage.tsx.
No URL.createObjectURL or URL.revokeObjectURL calls related to audio exist in ChapterPage.tsx or AudioPlayer.tsx.
The AudioPlayer renders an <audio> element with the URL as its src, without any URL validation or filtering.
If neither audio slot has a URL, the 'No audio available' empty-state UI is displayed.
Audio playback works for YouTube links, Google Drive links, and direct audio URLs in supported browsers.

file_operations.description: Remove all calls to getAudioData and getAudioData2 canister functions. Remove all URL.createObjectURL and URL.revokeObjectURL logic for audio blobs. Update the Audio tab to check for audioUrl1 and audioUrl2 on the chapter object. When audioUrl1 or audioUrl2 is present, render a named button/card using the chapter's audioLabel1 or audioLabel2 (with fallback to 'Audio 1' or 'Audio 2'). When a button is clicked, pass the corresponding audioUrl1 or audioUrl2 string directly to the AudioPlayer component's src prop. If neither audioUrl1 nor audioUrl2 is present, display the existing 'No audio available' empty-state UI. Remove any state variables related to audio blob fetching or URL creation.

Ensure the AudioPlayer accepts the URL prop as-is and passes it directly to the <audio> element's src attribute without any validation, filtering, or blob URL creation. Remove any URL.createObjectURL or URL.revokeObjectURL calls. The component should render the <audio> element with the provided URL and display an error message only if the browser cannot load the resource. Ensure the external link fallback button works with any URL type (YouTube, Google Drive, direct audio, etc.).

requirements.summary: Update frontend types and mapper to include audioUrl1 and audioUrl2 fields, removing binary audio blob references
acceptanceCriteria: The Chapter TypeScript interface in chapter.ts includes optional audioUrl1?: string and audioUrl2?: string fields.
chapterMapper.ts correctly maps backend audioUrl1 and audioUrl2 fields to the frontend Chapter type.
No references to hasAudio or hasAudio2 binary-audio flags remain in chapterMapper.ts or chapter.ts.
Existing fields (notesUrl1, notesLabel1, notesUrl2, notesLabel2, audioLabel1, audioLabel2, etc.) remain unchanged.

file_operations.description: Add optional audioUrl1?: string and audioUrl2?: string fields to the Chapter interface. Remove any hasAudio or hasAudio2 boolean fields related to binary audio storage. Ensure all other existing fields (notesUrl1, notesLabel1, notesUrl2, notesLabel2, audioLabel1, audioLabel2, quizQuestions, flashcards, etc.) remain unchanged.

Update the chapter mapping function to include audioUrl1 and audioUrl2 fields from the backend Chapter type (as defined in backend.d.ts) to the frontend Chapter type. Remove any logic that maps hasAudio or hasAudio2 binary-audio flags. Ensure all other field mappings (notesUrl1, notesLabel1, notesUrl2, notesLabel2, audioLabel1, audioLabel2, etc.) remain unchanged.
